operators.name: gelu_forward
semantics: Computes the element-wise Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation: gelu(x) = x * 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2))), matching PyTorch F.gelu with default approximate='none'.
No bias, no broadcast; operates elementwise on every element of x.
Returns a new contiguous tensor of identical shape, dtype, and device.

operators.name: prod_dim1_keepdim_forward
semantics: Computes the product of elements along dimension 1, keeping the dimension: prod(x, dim=1, keepdim=True).
The product is computed over the 128 channels for each (batch, height, width) location independently.
Output shape becomes [16, 1, 512, 256] with the product stored in the second dimension.
Element-wise GELU activation as described by PyTorch F.gelu default (approximate='none') for float32.
Product along dimension 1 with keepdim=True, reducing [16,128,512,256] to [16,1,512,256].
